themeMenu.title: Themes
themeMenu.content: Selecting a theme displays the map layers defined for the theme and opens a menu for selecting map materials related to the theme. Some of the map materials have their own style for the theme. There can be only one theme at a time. When a theme is selected, you can also select map materials other than those defined for the theme in the All Levels menu. The theme closes with the theme marker at the top of the map. The name of the theme can be clipped in the theme marker, but by clicking it, the full name will be displayed and hidden.

content.general:
You can search for a map layer by name by typing 3 characters into the search field. The dataset list can be filtered by topic using the 'Filter by type' menu, or you can save an 'custom filter' of selected datasets to the browser cache (available from the filter options). Custom filter is available only on the device and browser where it was saved.
Clicking the info icon next to a layer name opens the dataset metadata. If a download button is shown next to the layer, the dataset is available for download for the whole of Finland. If the download button is missing, downloading the dataset requires selecting features on the map.
Some datasets can be filtered based on their attribute data. If filtering is available for a dataset, a filter icon is shown next to the layer.
content.ownDatasets:
'My datasets' contains the views and geometries saved by the user, which can be displayed, edited and deleted.
Saved views and geometries are currently stored only in the browser cache, so they are only available on the device and browser where they were saved.
Metadata for personal geometries and views can be viewed via the info button. A star icon is shown next to the name of a view set as the default. Default views are activated automatically when the page is opened.
content.ownDatasetsExtranet:
'My datasets' contains the views, geometries and personal map layers saved by the user, which can be displayed, edited and deleted.
Saved views and geometries are currently stored only in the browser cache, so they are only available on the device and browser where they were saved. Userlayers are stored in the database and fetched for each user. At the moment it is not possible to share userlayers.
Metadata for personal geometries and views can be viewed via the info button. A star icon is shown next to the name of a view set as the default. Default views are activated automatically when the page is opened.
content.selectedLayers: 'Selected layers' contains a list of the map layers chosen for display. You can reorder layers by dragging them using the handle on the left. Opacity can be adjusted with the slider and a layer can be toggled on or off using the checkbox. The filter button opens filtering options where visible map data can be filtered based on attribute values.

search.title: Search
search.content: The search is opened from the magnifying-glass button in the top-right corner of the map. With the search function you can look for municipalities, addresses, real estate unit identifiers, street addresses or railway addresses. More detailed search instructions can be found by opening the arrow button in the window that appears when you choose more search criteria. Search instructions can be opened and closed per search type using the info icon. You can remove search terms from the map by clicking the trash icon in the search field, and results can be removed from the map using the 'Clear results' button. When search results are active, the search window can be hidden.

featureSelection.title: Feature selection
featureSelection.content: You can select features on the map using different selection methods, such as drawtools, previously saved geometries, or predefined area geometries. The window will automatically minimize when the selection tool is activated. After a selection is made and the feature information has been fetched, it will open in the 'Feature data' window. When the 'Feature data' window or the 'Feature selection' window is closed, the selection is also cleared from the map. An active selection button can be deactivated by pressing the same button again or by choosing another one.

drawingTools.title: Drawing tools
drawingTools.content: The drawing tools are opened from the window that opens from the left hand side tool button. With the tools you can add geometries to the map and measure length or area. The 'Marker' button opens a menu for adding various map markers, plus you can add text to these annotations. Drawn geometries and annotations can be saved by clicking the 'Save' button, which is the bottom button in the drawing tools. Saving also applies to geometries drawn on the map by other functions, such as points added with the coordinate tool, as well as search results drawn on the map. When saving geometries you give them a name and, optionally, a description. Drawn geometries can be removed from the map using the orange 'Erase' button. Saved geometries are listed under 'My datasets' in the map layers menu.

gfi.content:
To access feature data, click anywhere on the map or click the button with the marker icon on the left. In the Feature Data window, you can search for feature data and view information about the features and locations you select, which you can also download directly to your device in a file format of your choosing. If there is a filter-button next to the map layer name, you can filter data listed in the Feature Data window.
If you have selected the object by clicking the map, you can explore the same location from Google Street View service. Google Street View can be opened from the location informations at the Feature Data window.
Use the 'Target' button to center the map on the selected features.

shareWebsite.title: Share map view
shareWebsite.content: You can share the current map view via a link to a selected service or by copying the link. The view preserves language, center position, zoom level, selected map layers and the chosen theme.

tools.title: Tools
tools.content: The tools contain functions such as drawing tools, saving views and downloads.

coordinateTool.title: Coordinate tool
coordinateTool.content: The coordinate tool shows the coordinates of the map centre. You can also enter coordinates manually, which activates the 'Center map' button; pressing it will centre the map on that point. You can optionally add a marker at the centre, and these markers can be saved to your geometries.

location.title: My location
location.content: The location tool enables tracking of the user's position on the map.

baseLayers.title: Background maps selection
baseLayers.content: The background map buttons shown at the bottom of the map can be managed from the pen icon at the bottom of the page. In the opened window you can select up to four layers and change the order they are shown in at the bottom of the page.

filter.title: Filtering

step2.title: Select an attribute
step2.content: Choose an attribute from the dropdown menu to filter the layer's data.

content.equal: Equals: Displays objects whose attribute is exactly the same as the given value.
content.notEqual: Not equal: Displays objects whose attribute differs from the given value.
content.contains: Contains: Displays objects whose attribute includes the given value.
content.notContains: Does not contain: Displays objects whose attribute does not include the given value.
content.smallerThan: Smaller than: smaller than the given value
content.biggerThan: Bigger than: bigger than the given value

step4.title: Enter value
step4.content: Provide the value to use for filtering with your selected attribute.

step6.title: Removing the filter
step6.content: If desired, you can remove the applied filter by pressing "Remove all filters" or by clicking the cross next to active filters.

filter.additionalInstructions: Using the operators 'Contains' and 'Does not contain', the attribute value does not need to be perfectly correct. It is sufficient that the value is only part of the attribute's content. This facilitates filtering when the exact value is not known. Filtering uses 'AND' logic, meaning each additional filter narrows down the result set.
filter.feedback: If the filter tool is missing from the layer or the attribute to be filtered is missing an essential attribute, you can send feedback on the subject to

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.content: Downloads open from the Downloads button from the tools window. From the popup you can make a new feature selection to download and manage previous downloads made from feature data window.

views.title: Save views
views.content: 'Save view' is found in the tools window. Saving a view stores the map view in the browser cache. The saved view includes the map centre, zoom level and selected layers. You assign a name to the view and optionally a description. A view can also be set as the default view so that it is activated automatically when the application starts. Saved views are available on the device and in the browser where they were stored. Saved views are listed under 'My datasets' in the map layer menu.

datasetImport.title: Import datasets
datasetImport.content: 'Import datasets' is found in the tools window. With this tool you can import your own datasets into the service and specify a name, description, data source and styles. More detailed instructions are available in the popup that opens.

setFullScreen.title: Expand
setFullScreen.content: The Expand button can be used to expand the Suomen Vaylat application to fill the entire screen.

zoomBar.title: Captions / Zoom Bar
zoomBar.content: You can open the zoom level and the map layers with their captions on the map at that zoom level from the caption icon at the bottom right. Map layers are listed at the top first. Selecting another scale from the zoom bar moves to the selected approach level.

appInfo.title: Application details
appInfo.headingText: Suomen väylät is a map service provided by the Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency. The service, based on open data geographical information, was launched in 2022 and it currently contains more than 270 data types and their attributes. The service and its contents are continuously developed.
appInfo.mainText: Using the Suomen väylät map service, you can view road data on the state-owned road network, rail data and waterway data. Data on infrastructure projects of the Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency, and the data types of Digiroad (National Road and Street Database) are also included as separate datasets. The service contains several thematic maps, such as a project map and the Finnish Railway Network Statement. In Suomen väylät, you can search for data by name or subject and filter data by theme. The map service also has separate address, road and metadata search functions. Suomen väylät is supplied as desktop and mobile versions and the service is available in Finnish, Swedish and English.  For instructions, click the ? button (link). Suomen väylät is currently operated and maintained by Sitowise Oy.

298.title: Digiroad
298.description: Digiroad is a national dataset under the responsibility of the Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency, which contains the centre line geometries of the road network and attribute data related to traffic. Digiroad is an information system that collects data from the Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency’s Road Register, the National Land Survey of Finland’s Topographic Database, municipal street information systems and the information systems of a few other authorities (for example, HSL Helsinki Region Transport.

562.title: Trans-European transport network TEN-T
562.description: The TEN-T network comprises two levels: the core network, to be completed by 2030 and the comprehensive network to be completed by 2050. The TEN-T core network focuses on the most important connections and hubs. The implementation of the core network is advanced by a corridor-based approach. The TEN-T network covers all forms of transport: road, air, internal waterways and sea, as well as platforms enabling a combination of different forms of transport.

2.title: Rail traffic
2.description: The dataset covers the railways owned by the Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency. The source system of the dataset is the railway infrastructure information management system's track object management application RATKO.

199.title: Engineering structure
199.description: The engineering structure register is the Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency’s basic data repository and asset management system, which contains administrative and structural information. The data content of the engineering structure register includes bridges, tunnels, railway drums, docks and canal structures.

727.title: Road Register
727.description: The Road Register contains information on highways that are under the responsibility of the Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency and traffic on the highways. The Road Register is being decommissioned. The road register datasets presented in Suomen väylät have been removed from the Road Register on 17 February 2022
727.link_description: Description of the information content of the road register

101.title: Waterway
101.description: The dataset covers the waterways and canals under the responsibility of the Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency. The maintenance and development of waterways and canals take account of the navigation needs of merchant shipping and other waterborne traffic.
